description: Per-lane median of three unsigned bytes (rank 1 of 3), four lanes deep. Lane k reads A=a[8k+:8], B=b[8k+:8], C=c[8k+:8] and writes result[8k+:8]=median(A,B,C) as max(min(A,B),min(max(A,B),C)) - three comparators per lane, no adder, no sort. aux[3:0]=lanes where at least two of the three inputs are equal (a tie, so the median is also the min or the max). aux[7:4]=lanes where all three inputs are equal. aux[31:8] is always zero. No fault condition: every input word is a legal triple and a median of bytes can never overflow.
hardware_advantage: Salt-and-pepper rank filtering costs three compares and two branches per pixel in firmware; four lanes of the min/max network settle in one cycle, so the sensor pipeline moves 4 pixels per enabled beat with the tie flags produced in the same beat.
provenance: original source authored in this workspace; no third-party RTL imported
